launches.body:
Veronica and Sophia here, we’re building Harbera. Harbera is AI software that helps healthcare organizations keep their providers - physicians, dentists, nurse practitioners - in-network with insurers and compliant.

<https://youtu.be/75SKmVEMBvs>

## Without credentials doctors can’t treat patients

Credentialing is the bureaucratic process of verifying a providers’ qualifications and contracting them with insurance plans. The 900+ insurance companies across the U.S. have different and ever-changing credentialing requirements, and providers need to be re-credentialed regularly. 

Keeping providers credentialed is critical. If a provider falls out-of-network, it can take months to get credentialed again. Health systems are often unaware that a provider has fallen out-of-network until claims start getting denied, leading to disrupted patient care and billions in lost revenue.

## Monitoring credentialing is hard and gets harder at scale

There’s a lot that administrators need to keep track of: updates to insurance plan requirements (often mailed), license and certification expirations, malpractice sanctions, re-credentialing timelines, and more. Today, many back-office teams at hospitals and clinic groups use spreadsheets, filing cabinets, or even repurpose tools like Salesforce to track credentialing.

Here’s why monitoring is challenging for organizations:

* A telehealth company that accepts 10 insurance plans and works with 100 therapists across 30 states needs to track up to 30,000 statuses.
* A dental group working with 200 dentists needs to track 8,000 statuses. (Dentists are enrolled in over 40 insurance plans on average.)

## What we’re doing

We are making credentialing easy. Our software integrates with a healthcare organization’s existing systems to continuously monitor and proactively re-credential providers across states and insurance plans. We keep administrators in the loop so providers never fall out-of-network. We make onboarding new providers seamless with real-time document validation. We analyze credentialing trends to identify revenue growth opportunities and optimize staffing.

## About us

We’re best friends from college. We studied and taught Computer Science together at Harvard. [Veronica](https://www.linkedin.com/in/veronicanutting/) was a software engineer at Stripe, and [Sophia](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sophia--clark/) was a software engineer at House Rx, a specialty pharmacy software startup serving clinics across the country.

## Ask

Do you know health leaders that work in multi-state or multi-practice healthcare organizations, like dental support organizations (DSOs), telehealth companies, hospitals, or clinic groups? We’d love to meet them!

Email [founders@harbera.com](mailto:founders@harbera.com) to get in touch 🦡🧡

launches.body:
Hey everyone, we’re [Nikhil](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nikhiltiwari-iitb/) & [Shivesh](https://www.linkedin.com/in/shivesh-gupta-iitb/), co-founders of Frekil!  👋

## TL;DR

Frekil is an end-to-end platform to procure and annotate medical imaging datasets like Xrays, CTs, MRIs, etc 10x faster with AI assistance. We’ve partnered with radiology chains for large-scale imaging data, and have a global marketplace of radiologists for rapid, high-quality annotations.

https://youtu.be/2MYjUFp3r0Q?feature=shared

## ❗The Problem

AI is transforming healthcare, but the biggest bottleneck is still **access to medical images from hospitals and annotations by expert doctors**.

Healthcare AI and life sciences companies spend millions collecting medical images and hiring expert radiologists. But annotations? They're still:

📝 Manual\
🐢 Slow\
🔍 Hard to QA

Finding expert annotators with deep domain knowledge is tough, which means R&D teams waste months and large budgets on a process that should be seamless.

Medical annotation itself is uniquely challenging because it involves:

📦 Gigabyte-scale files\
🧠 Complex, multi-dimensional data that’s sensitive to loss\
🎯 Accuracy that’s absolutely critical

Yet most teams still use open-source desktop tools like 3D Slicer, built decades ago for solo researchers. These tools:

🚫 Require local machines\

Highly trained radiologists are stuck doing repetitive tasks manually wasting time, slowing innovation, and compromising data quality.

Here’s how:

✅ Deliver fully annotated **medical datasets** tailored for AI research needs

✅ Provide certified and benchmarked **radiologists** for annotation and quality assurance

✅ Offer advanced, browser-based annotation tools for all kinds of medical images—radiology, pathology, histopathology, including X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, etc

✅ Use **AI assistance** to make annotators **10x faster**

✅ Enable customizable clinical workflows with multi-stage reviews & annotations

✅ Ensure **FDA-Ready** annotation versioning, consensus checks, and full audit trails

✅ Track annotator performance in cost, time, and **accuracy** - all built in

launches.title: Morphik: Open‑source multimodal RAG that works on technical docs
launches.tagline: Turn your complex private data into grounded answers
launches.body:
Hey YC! 👋 We’re Adi and Arnav, co-founders of Morphik (https://morphik.ai).

### **TL;DR**

* **Problem:** Knowledge workers spend a lot of their time searching complex documentation with diagrams, tables, or spreadsheets, just to find relevant information. Text‑only RAG misses details, hallucinates, and provides half-baked responses.
* **Solution:** Morphik embeds whole pages (image + text, no OCR), auto‑builds a knowledge graph, and serves it through a UI, SDK, or REST API. We have 90 % accuracy on arXiv QA (and we can fine-tune for your use case 🙂).

Watch our demo video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3adZQhm5JZY

### **Problem**

RAG breaks the moment documents stop being blobs of text.

* Knowledge workers spend a lot of their time (people we spoke with said 50-70% time just in the research phase). eg. electrical engineers finding perfect PCB spec, pharma companies trying to search ELNs for similar experiments.
* 80% of enterprise knowledge lives in diagrams, tables, images, CAD, scanned pdfs, not .txt.
* “Multimodal” models still hallucinate or miss key context because the retrieval step sees only text, or they rely on tools to retrieve diagrams, or context. (https://docs.morphik.ai/blogs/gpt-vs-morphik-multimodal)
* Teams glue together OCR, vector DBs, and regex‑heavy ETL that becomes a brittle monstrosity.

### **Solution**

Directly embedding and search over page images

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdzvQJeEBmnvZI1Mkl2ZYCtsN0AG4Mx5JpcN4RtivMfndGshgTkj1uZcb8BkFAkXXNCpg9TPqeIKsqCXscaLzGDNO2e8TFn8naJPkJ_XtceDHlwNrAAcV69QGYlzSOwvdofI7FksQ?key=wmYsqYRKzN1ploJFaFpgwCeu)

When you ingest in Morphik, in addition to OCR, we create direct embeddings for the image of a page (or frames in a video). When you ask “Colpali comparison to standard RAG”, the LLM sees the actual page image, so multimodal models can reason over arrows, labels, scales, and colours just like a human.

### **Rules Engine**

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcOXXa3wTpZV26zi8kaucVOt2QuUgKKfrdvlyqlFfeHmDUudWpNaS-r6KNm5--4Joz4rE5tsiu_NDqlHnRE914l7ad4YtKRRLc_X1gm7BteBR0aMN446aia7LGA1l7b2UJMor97?key=wmYsqYRKzN1ploJFaFpgwCeu)

When ingesting, you can define rules for data extraction (which would again consider tables, diagrams), or define natural language rules for PII redaction, or content transformation.

### **Deployment ready, scalable**

Morphik comes built in with folder scoping, end user scoping, GPU accelerations, and fine grained permissions, so you can prototype and deploy with enterprise grade features. It’s end‑to‑end, so you don’t scramble to make duct tape fixes.

### **One more thing…Morphik Research Agent**

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcL9LvkrH861vRDhuFlYlBy0LsjlhMOYVBLRLdnj903G5L3QMgx12ziGZJhO_h2SzAakjD27e0Yeu4XZwmsE4Yv1BGNRj-OGc41i798xy_UW9MVHISzJy0GBrTsOWWqWBGdtGKhmg?key=wmYsqYRKzN1ploJFaFpgwCeu)

Our research agent uses Morphik’s retrieval, graph, and extraction APIs as tools. It chains them automatically, jumping from doc to doc, node to node, seeing figures, till it finds the needle in the haystack, or has enough context to answer your questions. “Describe the third pin on the USBC21 diagram” will get the diagram, find the pin, jump to the table with pin descriptions, jump to page 13 to “find more details on page 13”.

### **Why we might be interesting to you**

* Building an internal ChatGPT over messy manuals? Morphik is the fastest way to ship something users _trust_.
* Developing an AI product? Swap your vector‑DB‑plus‑duct‑tape stack for a single SDK call.
* Researching graph‑RAG? CAG? We have it all.

### **Our Ask 🙏**

1. **⭐ Star / watch** https://github.com/morphik-org/morphik-core – open source momentum matters.
2. **Introductions** to teams drowning in technical docs (healthcare, manufacturing, legal, electrical engineers).
3. Tell us **what still hurts in your RAG stack**, comment, **DM, or email** [founders@morphik.ai](mailto:founders@morphik.ai) or [book a call](https://cal.com/adityavardhan-agrawal-x6jyhq/30min).

Thanks for reading!

Adi & Arnav

name: chrt

chrt is a logistics platform for time-critical shipping. We enable businesses to deliver their most critical items same-day.

Time-Critical Logistics is a $30B market growing at a 20% CAGR driven by growth in American healthcare and manufacturing.

Businesses that place time-critical orders are enterprises who have urgent items they need to deliver ASAP. These orders are critical in nature and often require white glove service -- think therapeutic treatments for healthcare providers or specialized equipment for manufacturers. 

chrt builds the software for forwarders and professional couriers who pick up and deliver these orders. Couriers use chrt to coordinate and track their shipments, including a driver app and fleet management tools. Forwarders use chrt to dispatch couriers, book flights, and track time-critical orders from start to finish. Shippers use chrt to place these orders with their providers and to monitor everything. 

In addition, we also sell physical tracking devices that can be used to track valuable cargo or assets.

This gives us full control of the shipment and allows us to provide shippers with end-to-end tracking. It also allows us to intervene early if we notice something is going wrong.

We’re software engineers that became friends years ago at McKinsey. Kyle is an expert in Time-Critical Logistics, having led strategy at a leader in the space. Aaron is an expert at designing and implementing AI systems to handle complex coordination. We were shipping code together on nights and weekends for years before chrt; now we’re also shipping freight.

launches.title: Pelica: the AI operating system for value-based care
launches.tagline: AI agents that capture the risk, close the gaps, and make the calls, so small teams can keep whole populations healthy.
launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋 We’re Lalit and Catherine, co-founders of Pelica Health.

## **TL;DR**

Pelica is the AI operating system for value-based care. We pull claims, EHR, pharmacy, lab, and hospital feeds into **one canonical record**, then run AI copilots that read and write to it: risk adjustment, Stars and quality, pharmacy, provider network, and care management, plus an AI data analyst you can ask anything in plain English. The copilots **do the operational work themselves**: capturing HCCs in real time, closing gaps once across every payer, and making outreach calls in the member’s language. HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2 Type II, and RADV-defensible.

We’re live with a physician-led IPA in New York, one of the largest independent medical groups in the Northeast: **2,500+ hours saved** and higher CMS Star Ratings so far.

▶️ Watch their story: <https://youtu.be/2CGmyif9Yd4>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103962&key=user_uploads/1494518/e873acc4-f206-4eca-8617-9bf7f70f3b62)

_An AI agent works one gap end to end: provider office, pharmacy, the member in their language, the payer portal, then a live call. Closed in 3 minutes of staff time._

## **🚩 The problem**

Value-based care pays a medical group or health plan to keep a whole population healthy, and billions in CMS bonuses ride on it. The teams who own those contracts decide whether the org makes money, and they cannot operate:

• Their data lives in 8 to 15 systems. By the time a problem surfaces, the submission window has closed.

• Risk calls a member. Quality calls the same member. The practice calls again, sometimes in a language the member doesn’t speak.

• The best predictive model is worthless if it never reaches the provider.

• The rules keep moving. Hybrid HEDIS is retiring into ECDS volumes many times higher per measure, and the V28 phase-in costs the average MA plan about 3% of RAF.

Every new gap gets a new point vendor, each with its own portal, data model, and login. These teams do not need another point tool. They need an operating system.

## **🛠️ What we built**

One canonical record, with an AI workforce next to every team. Six copilots:

• **Risk Adjustment:** real-time HCC capture with trumping logic and RADV-defensible chain of custody on every code.

• **Quality and Stars:** gap closure unified across every payer, with year-round forecasting for the post-hybrid HEDIS world.

• **Pharmacy and Part D:** PDC lift on the three triple-weighted measures that move Stars the most.

• **Provider Network:** auto-built practice agendas that cut meeting prep from 90 minutes to 15.

• **Care Management:** ADT-driven transitions-of-care worklists, with no duplicate calls across teams.

• **AI Data Analyst:** plain-English questions against the record, in place of the BI ticket queue.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103962&key=user_uploads/1494518/13a2d9aa-5ac8-4ab4-bf2c-b61fe8bccb56)

_Risk Adjustment: the agent works the EHR and payer portals like a person and captures a defensible HCC._

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103962&key=user_uploads/1494518/cfb57b8c-bf75-43d1-9dc3-d29da891d8e9)

_AI Data Analyst: ask your RAF in plain English, get an answer and a chart in seconds._

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103962&key=user_uploads/1494518/4bbf9afb-abc0-4221-9e5b-bf4602654e32)

_Provider Network: reps walk in prepped, and the visit is captured into tasks automatically._

It runs on the systems VBC teams already use: Epic, Cerner, Athena, eCW, payer SFTP, PBM feeds, ADT, and labs, with SMART-on-FHIR overlays in Epic and Athena. A new source onboards in days, and the copilots start working the day after.

## **📈 Early proof**

That physician-led IPA went from three uncoordinated calls per member to one outreach, in the right language, that closed three gaps at once. No new headcount. One of their leaders put it simply: “You don’t just get software, you get partners.”

## **👫 Why us**

Catherine and I met at YouTube and have built large-scale systems together since. We saw the same gap from two sides: clinical AI that could not operate, and operations software that could not reason clinically.

• **Catherine** led AI work on Gemini and enterprise agents at Google, did clinical AI research at Stanford School of Medicine, and saw front-line care at clinics in California and New Hampshire. BA in Computer Science from Dartmouth.

• **Lalit** spent 8 years building software for regulated industries at Google and YouTube, most recently as engineering and ML lead on YouTube Payments, running a 45-person team on products driving $16B+ in revenue. Wharton MBA, ACM-ICPC World Finalist.

Backed by Y Combinator, SurgePoint Capital, Upside Partnership, ISEED Ventures, and Progressive Ventures.

## **🙏 Our ask**

• Warm intros to VPs of Risk Adjustment, Stars, Quality, or Pharmacy at MA plans, IPAs, MSOs, or ACOs.

• Intros to ACO executive directors running MSSP or REACH.

• If you run risk-bearing contracts at a health plan, IPA, MSO, ACO, or medical group, email [lalit@pelica.com](mailto:lalit@pelica.com) or book a demo at cal.com/pelica/pelica.

Follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7475922350316732416/) and [X](https://x.com/cthrnzh/status/2070159740295160294), and learn more at [pelica.com](http://pelica.com).

If you run risk-bearing contracts at a health plan, IPA, MSO, ACO, or medical group, email [lalit@pelica.com](mailto:lalit@pelica.com) or book a demo at [cal.com/pelica](https://cal.com/pelica/pelica-demo).

## 🚩 The Problem

VBC teams own the contracts that decide whether the org makes money. They cannot operate. Today:

* Data lives in 12 places. By the time a problem surfaces, the submission window has closed.
* Risk calls a member. Quality calls the same member. The practice calls again. Sometimes in a language the member doesn't speak.
* The best predictive model is useless if it never reaches the provider.
* Hybrid HEDIS is retiring. ECDS volumes run 35 to 75 times higher per measure. The old infra was not built for it.
* V28 phase-in finishes in 2026. The average MA plan loses roughly 3% of RAF.

Point vendors keep stacking up. One for retrospective coding. One for HEDIS. One for adherence. One for ADT. Each with its own portal, its own data model, its own login.

VBC teams need more than another point tool. They need an operating system.

## 🛠️ Our Solution

We built Pelica, an AI operating system for value-based care. Three layers, six copilots, one canonical record.

* **🌐 HIPAA + SOC 2 Type II:** Tenant-isolated, encrypted end-to-end, zero-retention with every LLM provider in use.
* **🔌 Connects to every system:** Epic, Cerner, Athena, eCW, payer SFTP, PBM feeds, ADT, labs. SMART-on-FHIR overlays in Epic and Athena.
* **⚡ Live in weeks, not quarters:** A new data source onboards in days. Copilots start working the day after.

What Pelica can do:

* **🧾 Risk Adjustment Copilot:** Real-time HCC capture with trumping logic, MAO-004 awareness, and RADV-defensible chain-of-custody on every code.
* **⭐ Quality & Stars Copilot:** Unified gap closure across every payer, with year-round glide-path forecasting for the post-hybrid HEDIS world.
* **💊 Pharmacy & Part D Copilot:** PDC lift on the three triple-weighted measures. The 5 points that separate 4-star from 2-star.
* **🤝 Provider Network Copilot:** Auto-generated practice agendas. Meeting prep from 90 minutes to 15.
* **🏥 Care Management Copilot:** ADT-driven TOC worklists, 5-day follow-up tracking, no duplicate calls across teams.
* **📊 AI Data Analyst:** Plain-English questions against the canonical record. Replaces the BI ticket queue.

A Director of Risk Adjustment told us: "**Our data lives in twelve places. By the time we know there's a problem, the submission window has closed**." A Stars Program Manager told us: "We are solving the same problem five times." Same root cause. One shared record fixes both.

## 👫 The Team

Catherine and Lalit met at YouTube and have been building large-scale systems together ever since. They saw the same gap from two sides: clinical AI that could not operate, and operations AI that could not reason clinically.

**Catherine led AI work on Gemini and enterprise AI agents at Google**. She did clinical AI research at Stanford School of Medicine and saw front-line patient care at clinics in California and New Hampshire. BA in Computer Science from Dartmouth.

**Lalit spent 8 years building software for regulated industries at Google and YouTube**. He was Engineering and ML lead on YouTube Payments, running a 45-plus person team in Commerce Billing on products driving $16B+ in revenue. Wharton MBA. ACM-ICPC World Finalist.

Backed by Y Combinator, SurgePoint Capital, Upside Partnership, ISEED Ventures, and Progressive Ventures.

launches.body:
Hey YC.

My name is Eshan. I’ve spent the last 5 years trying to address what I think is the most pressing problem in the country — addiction and mental health. Before YC, I ran a group doing on the ground overdose prevention work across the country. I also worked at the White House on Drug Policy.

**Insurance companies love to scrutinize behavioral health treatment**, partially because it’s expensive (a single 30-day residential treatment episode can cost upwards of $50,000), and partially because proving medical necessity for behavioral health is a subjective process.

But behavioral health care _is_ medically necessary. **Drug overdose is the single biggest cause of death for young people in the US.** And there are too many stories of insurers denying people care, only for those individuals to later lose their lives to overdose.

We were in the summer ‘25 YC batch. Since then, we’ve been working with a small group of customers to develop a new product. I’m excited to announce it today.\
\
**Introducing: Perspectives Reclaim**

Because they’re under so much pressure from payors, behavioral health treatment programs currently spend an immense amount of resources and staff generating documentation and auditing it to be perfect. \
\
Reclaim solves this by

1. Reading tens of thousands of pages of charts every night
2. Finding issues that can lead to insurance denials or other issues
3. Tracking down which clinician made the error and emailing back and forth with them until it’s solved.  

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101622&key=user_uploads/2329278/a7ccf9c3-cf38-409a-a8d4-9c4421623a19)

\
In each of our pilots, we’ve flagged and resolved hundreds of issues, from missing documents to drug tests that weren’t happening when they were supposed to, **leading to more approvals from payors, higher revenue for our clinics, and better outcomes for patients.**

Reclaim’s agent can also help provide evidence when fighting against payor clawbacks and can generate the insurance documentation used to argue for more days of care.

In the last 4 weeks since launching Reclaim, we’ve gone from **0 —> $250k cARR.** Our vision is to replace the $30B spent on the financial and administrative services that keep these clinics afloat and give that capacity back to care.

**Asks**:

1. Intros to our ICP: we’re looking for multi-site behavioral health/SUD treatment centers that deal with commercial insurance.
2. We’re currently hiring a senior software engineer to help us scale. Any intros here would be appreciated.
3. Investor intros are always appreciated as well.

Here’s our launch video: <https://youtu.be/vvFe7AF3mUo>

**Perspectives Health is the AI assistant automating the admin work that slows down behavioral health clinics.**

[https://youtu.be/xL-XqY41L10](https://youtu.be/xL-XqY41L10%5C)

Hey everyone! We're Eshan and Kyle, founders of Perspectives Health.

We help the millions of clinicians and clinical directors finally use AI inside the outdated EMR systems they've been stuck in.

Most clinical record software works like Microsoft 95, has no modern APIs, and can't integrate with new tools. That leaves clinicians stuck doing endless manual computer work. 

Believe it or not, most behavioral health clinicians will spend 5 years of their lives just typing notes!

**The Problem**

* 60%+ of clinicians work outside of major hospital systems.
* Most of them use software that nobody can connect to.
* This means they can't access life-changing AI software, which could automate notes, billing, scheduling, and more.

**Our Solution**

* Connects to any web-based EMR instantly. Yes, we mean any EMR.
* Perspectives listens to sessions, writes notes better than a clinician, and populates them straight into any EMR. 
* No copy/paste. And we don't rely on browser agents, so our tool fills out any form in seconds, not minutes.

AI is rapidly improving, but most of healthcare is locked out due to legacy systems. Perspectives bridges that gap, making AI usable immediately. Clinicians want to help people. Not to be drowned in manual work. We're building toward a future where clinicians never touch a keyboard for documentation again—where intelligent systems handle every workflow outside of patient care. 

The first step is integrating seamlessly with outdated EMRs and filling in the critical workflows they lack. From there, we'll expand across specialties—behavioral health, speech therapy, physical therapy, veterinary care, and beyond—unlocking AI for every provider outside the hospital system.

**Our Traction**

* We're growing 25% every week.
* Once users try our product 5 times, the habit is built, and they never write notes without it.
* We have onboarded 9 clinics for our pilot program since YC started, and each is on track to onboard all our pilot clinicians by September (180 clinicians).

**Our Team**

Our founding team combines lived experience in mental health care, policy expertise from the White House Drug Policy team, and technical expertise in scalable AI systems.

**Our Ask**

If you're a behavioral health operator, clinician, or investor who believes AI should be helping providers now—not five years from now—let's talk.

launches.body:
# **⏳TL/DR**

Rovi helps employees access high-quality, cost-effective healthcare. We text employees the best in-network options at exactly the right moment, and handle all the complexity.

* Our AI-enabled virtual care treats common conditions quickly over text or video.
* For complex care, our AI agents search across all in-network providers using millions of price and quality data points, then handle scheduling and logistics.
* Employees get rewarded for choosing high-value care through copay reimbursements and waived deductibles.

Launch video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mKNB0CF8_9Y

# **⚠️ The Problem**

Healthcare costs are crushing employers. 2025 is seeing a 9% rate hike, the worst in a decade. A 1,000-person company now faces over $1M in cost increases annually, compounding.

Employers’ only options are to cut benefits or redesign their entire plan. Both take months and frustrate employees.

What if Employers could offset these costs by adding benefits instead?

## **🤨 How is this possible?**

**Price and quality have no correlation in healthcare:**

* The same MRI: $700 at an imaging center vs $2,500 at a hospital. Same network. Same machine.
* The same knee surgery: $7,000 at a surgery center vs $25,000 at a hospital. Same surgeon. Often better outcomes at the surgery center.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94971&key=user_uploads/1230817/7a7a2b27-4c82-410c-9744-82a5af6b1cc2)

**So why does everyone end up with the expensive option?**

1. **Hospitals own the referral pipeline.** They consolidated most primary care practices. When your doctor orders a procedure, their systems automatically directs it to their expensive facilities.
2. **Shopping is impossible.** Prices are hidden, provider directors outdated, quality is opaque. And when you're sick, calling twelve clinics is the last thing you want to do.

**Rovi does the hard work.** Our AI agents analyze terabytes of pricing data, research every provider's quality metrics, and surface options matching each person's preferences for cost, convenience, and availability. Making good healthcare decisions drives down costs for both the employee and the employer.

# **🎯 Impact**

We save employers 10-20% on healthcare spend while improving care outcomes and delivering a health benefit that employees love.

We've already signed contracts to roll out to thousands of employees across multiple employers for the 2025-2026 plan year.

## **🙏🏾 Our ask**

1. **Employers:** We have two final Q1 spots for self-funded employers. Introductions to employer benefits teams, brokers, health plans, and TPAs are welcome. Reach out to [santosh@rovihealth.com](mailto:santosh@rovihealth.com).
2. **Individuals:** [**Join our beta**](https://rovi.health/) to try our AI care concierge. Rovi will find you great in-network doctors whenever you need care. Virtual care coming soon.

## **👬🏾 Our team**

We're brothers on a mission to build AI-native health insurance that members love.

**Santosh** was previously building Cedar's affordability products, scaling to millions in ARR by closing enterprise deals with the country's largest hospital systems. Before that, he led a 30-person GTM & Customer Success team at AngelList. He’s also a licensed health insurance broker.

**Tarun** built foundational AI models to predict extreme weather events at UChicago, where he earned a Master's in AI and high-performance computing. He has a B.S. in biology from Cornell, and is obsessed with using AI to solve healthcare's messiest data problems.

Every week, U.S. healthcare billing teams make tens of millions of calls to insurance companies to get claims paid.\
Each one averages **25 minutes**. That’s how hospitals unlock part of the **$260B in denied or delayed payments** every year.

But there’s a bottleneck:

* Reps can only handle a few calls per hour.
* Staffing is expensive and hard to scale.
* Delays cost millions in unrecovered revenue.

Meanwhile, every new hospital system or insurer integration compounds the complexity.

### **💡 The Solution**

LunaBill’s **AI voice callers** automate those phone conversations end-to-end.

Our voice agents:

* Handle **claim status checks, appeals follow-ups, and reprocessing calls** automatically.
* **Connect to any billing software** and dial claims that need to be worked.
* Run up to **100 concurrent agents** per client, like having a 100-person call center on demand.
* Deliver post-call summaries with the to-do steps, integrated directly into workflows.

They’re **fine-tuned on 1.2M+ real call transcripts**, understand payer logic, and sound completely natural.\
🎧 [Listen](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1jxi7GRUV4h1YDX8XkEYQdFzepboOQLq8/view?usp=sharing) to a real AI insurance call, see if you can guess who’s human.

To date, LunaBill has automated **60,000+ insurance calls**, saving billing teams over **20,000 hours** and recovering **$30M+** in payments that would otherwise be lost.

Billers now can complete 300+ claim follow-ups per day — up from about 25/day before LunaBill, a \~12x productivity improvement.

LunaBill has partnered with **top healthcare systems** and **three of the biggest enterprise billing companies** across the country.

launches.body:
**TL;DR: [Cova](https://cova.care/) is a licensed home care agency in Michigan. AI agents run the entire back office, which lets us pay caregivers the highest base rate in the state, charge families less, and help unpaid family caregivers get paid through programs they didn't know they qualified for.**

<https://youtu.be/28Xmk3izvks>

**The problem**

This is one of the largest, fastest-growing markets in the country. 11,000 Americans turn 65 every day, and 70% want to age at home. 53 million people are already unpaid family caregivers, over $1 trillion in economic value every year that the system doesn’t capture.

But getting someone into home care is brutal. The application and paperwork alone take weeks of back-and-forth across a caregiver, a patient and their family, a doctor, and a state caseworker, with paper forms bouncing between all of them. Most of that time isn't care; it's coordination. Most families give up before care ever starts, and caregivers wait unpaid.

When care finally begins, caregivers suffer from missed payments and poor coordination, affecting patients downstream. All of this because existing agencies aren’t built to handle care at scale.

**What Cova does**

We own the full stack: Cova is its own home care agency serving Medicaid, LTCI, and private-pay patients, and AI agents run it end to end.

* **Weeks → days.** AI agents handle the applications and paperwork that normally drags on for weeks in just a few days.
* **Zero FTE overhead = highest caregiver pay in the state.** AI agents do the coordination work, so we carry no non-caregiver headcount and pass that straight to caregivers as the highest base rate in Michigan.
* **We get family caregivers paid.** Millions are already caring for a loved one for free and qualify for programs they've never heard of. AI agents find those programs and get them enrolled and paid.
* **We bill the payers directly.** Because we own the agency, we make money the way agencies do, billing Medicaid, MCOs, LTCI, and private pay, just with a fraction of the cost structure.

**About the team**

**Jordan Ibe (Co-Founder)** – Studied Computer Science & Statistics at Cornell University. Previously a Forward Deployed Software Engineer on Palantir’s Healthcare team and Software Engineer at Uber.

**Ansh Tandon (Co-Founder)** – Completed a BSE & MSE in Bioengineering at the University of Pennsylvania. Previously a Deployment Strategist on Palantir’s Healthcare team and Researcher at Daffodil Health.

launches.title: Lattice Health: Monitoring and governance for deployed medical imaging AI
launches.tagline: Keeping your imaging models safe and compliant
launches.body:
Hey YC!

I'm Christine Park, founder of Lattice Health. We make sure the AI that hospitals deploy on medical imaging keeps working after it goes live.

Launch video: <https://youtu.be/p0l029tsmhs>

Website: <https://www.latticehealthai.com/>

**The problem.** Hospitals are adopting medical imaging AI faster than ever. But once a model is live, almost no one can answer a basic question: is it still working? Models drift, a scanner upgrade or a shift in the patient population can quietly degrade accuracy, and performance often varies across patient groups. Most of that goes unseen today, and it's the hospital, not the vendor, that carries the risk.

**What we built.** Lattice is a monitoring and governance layer for deployed imaging AI. We plug in beside the imaging pipeline as a read-only observer and continuously check each model: how well it agrees with the radiologist's read, whether it's drifting over time, and how it performs across patient subgroups. Then we turn that into the evidence hospitals need for safety, governance, and compliance. Lattice never touches patient care, it only watches, so if Lattice stops, care continues.

**Why now.** AI is moving into clinical use under a wave of new expectations from the FDA, ONC, and the ACR, and they all point to the same gap: continuous post-deployment monitoring. Hospitals are on the hook for it and have almost no tooling to do it.

**Our ask.** We'd love intros to health system and radiology leaders, CMIOs, and anyone running AI governance at a hospital, as well as imaging AI vendors who want their models monitored well in the field. And if you have thoughts or hard questions, drop them in the comments or email me at [christine@latticehealthai.com](mailto:christine@latticehealthai.com)

launches.tagline: We built a computation layer for health insurance that predicts the lowest true-cost coverage for anyone. We will be the national standard for how America chooses coverage, with the only engine that knows both what plans cost and what they actually do.
launches.body:
Hey everyone — we're **Chang and Bryan**, the founders of **Insurf**.

American health insurance is f\*\*\*ed: chosen by guesswork, enforced by denial. We built the engine that fixes both halves.

**TL;DR**

**Surely** computes the lowest-cost plan for anyone. **Inveto** fights denials for real clinics across Texas, Georgia, and California, and each contract-authorized, de-identified outcome becomes coverage data nobody else has. Everything Inveto learns, Surely knows.\
\
[https://drive.google.com/file/d/1x5B44OPfZxd-32UBeGT-0a5WVdMf3Jnl](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1x5B44OPfZxd-32UBeGT-0a5WVdMf3Jnl/view?usp=sharing)

**The problem: America picks health plans from one number**

More than 20 million Marketplace enrollees choose coverage off the sticker premium. That guess is expensive.

• In our data, the lowest-premium plan was the lowest-cost option in **0 of 2,000 simulated years**.

• In one example, the cheaper sticker would have cost **$8,052 more** in a single bad year.

• That's one person. Multiply the risk across a family. Across a company.

• This year alone, **four million Americans** found out what their plans actually cost — and walked away from coverage.

We compute.

**Surely — the cost engine**

Surely ranks all plans by what they'll actually cost: premiums, deductibles, drug tiers, networks, out-of-pocket caps. Every number sourced from government filings.

**Inveto — the denial workbench**

Clinics upload a denial and the clinical record; Inveto produces source-cited, physician-signed appeals and supported prior authorizations. Live with real clinics across Texas, Georgia, and California today.

**The moat is the join**

Every contract-authorized Inveto outcome becomes rights-cleared data about what plans actually do, including approvals, denials, appeals; Surely reads all of it. **What plans cost + what plans do. Nobody else has both.**

**Why now**

In 2028, health plans stop renewing automatically: 20 million+ people will re-choose coverage every single year — the largest forced re-shop in the history of American health insurance. $150 billion a year in premiums, re-decided annually.

And employers are next. The federal government projects **800,000 companies and 11 million+ people** will switch to ICHRA, where employees choose their own plans. That's a **trillion-dollar shift**. With Insurf, employers can expect to save **\~$5,000 per employee, per year**.

**Who we are**

Two friends who met during orientation at Brown. Chang got into medical school at 17, then worked a pharmacy counter watching thousands of people pay out of pocket for what they were promised. Bryan placed internationally in CS and physics competitions and has published IEEE research since high school.

**Our ask**

• Tired of overpaying for health insurance?

• Weighing ICHRA, or trying to cut your company's benefits spend?

• Running a specialty clinic buried in denials and prior auths?

See how much your company can save here: [insurf.io/audit](https://www.insurf.io/audit) or email [founders@insurf.io](mailto:founders@insurf.io) — we'll show you exactly what you'd save.

**Everyone sells plans. Nobody prices them. We compute.**

launches.body:
**TL;DR: Stratum builds AI agents that automate the slow, manual processes governments run on. We're starting with application review - clearing backlogs in a fraction of the time and saving agencies tens of billions a year.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=108362&key=user_uploads/1648613/f70bb601-955f-4c6c-946f-8d8c90d04fa6)

**The problem**

Governments run on manual work. Millions of complex processes - reviews, approvals, filings, claims -are still handled by hand, one file at a time, on software built long before AI existed.

Take application review. Every permit, license, patent, drug approval, and benefits claim in America is reviewed by hand, one file at a time. Millions sit in queues while people wait months and years: veterans on disability ratings, families on pensions, builders on permits.

The tools reviewers open every morning were built long before AI. So the work stays manual, and the queue only grows.

This isn't one broken workflow. It's how the entire government runs.

**What Stratum does**

Stratum builds AI agents that automate the slow, complex, manual processes governments run on.

We're starting with application review.

A reviewer uploads an application and selects the rubric to check it against. From there, an agent takes over: it plans the review, works through the file end to end, and checks every requirement, routing each step to the right model.

A human approves every outcome, and every step is fully auditable.

The difference is scale. Instead of one reviewer on one file, hundreds of agents run in parallel — clearing an entire backlog in the time it once took to review a single application.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=108362&key=user_uploads/1648613/e23f9409-271f-4879-95aa-374eb37ae64f)

**Who we are**

We're Vihaan (VJ) and Raj - brothers.

Vihaan (CTO): founding engineer #3 at Cadastral (acquired by Legora), waterloo dropout.

Raj (CEO): led GTM at Deel, dropped out of CS grad school at the University of Bath.

**Where this goes**

Application review is the first workflow. The mission is to integrate AI across every vertical inside the government.

Governments are among the largest, most complex organizations on earth — and almost none of it has been touched by modern AI. We're changing that, saving agencies tens, eventually hundreds, of billions a year and making the government one of the most efficient institutions in the world.

Looking to bring AI into your agency? Reach out to the team or book a demo [stratumindustries.co](https://stratumindustries.co/)

Contact: [founders@stratumindustries.co](mailto:founders@stratumindustries.co)

launches.title: Stratum Industries - clearing the entire U.S. Government backlog
launches.tagline: AI agents that review government applications end-to-end, so backlogs that took years clear in minutes.
launches.body:
**TL;DR**

Stratum builds AI agents that clear the U.S. government's backlog. A reviewer drops in an application, picks the rubric to check it against, and an agent plans, executes, and reviews the file end to end. Hundreds run in parallel with a human approving every decision, so a backlog that used to take months clears in the time it took to review one file.

**The Problem**

Every permit, license, patent, drug approval, grants and benefits claim in America has to be reviewed by a government adjudicator, on software built decades before AI. The result is millions of applications stuck in queues, and real people waiting months or years: veterans on disability ratings, families on pensions, builders on permits. The approval isn't the problem. The software it runs on is.

**How Stratum Works**

1. A reviewer drops in an application and selects the rubric it needs to be checked against.
2. An agent reads every page and checks the file against that rubric.
3. Every step routes to the model that reviews it most accurately for the least cost.
4. Anything missing goes back to the applicant as one specific request.
5. The officer gets the whole file summarized, with every citation behind it, and approves or denies it.

Hundreds of these run in parallel in the cloud, with full auditability at every step, and a person always makes the final call.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=108348&key=user_uploads/1648613/15e81a7e-32ca-4280-9822-bc49caed3028)

**The Vision**

In a couple of years, dealing with the government should feel as frictionless as booking an Uber or paying with Apple Pay. You tell your Stratum agent what you need, a permit, a license, a claim, and it fills out the application and submits it. On the other side, the government's Stratum agents review it, ask your agent for anything missing, and settle it between themselves. The decision comes back the same day, in minutes. No waiting weeks or months. Clearing today's backlog is only the beginning.

**Team**

We're Vihaan and Raj, brothers. Vihaan was founding engineer #3 at Cadastral (acquired by Legora) and dropped out of Waterloo to build Stratum. Raj led GTM at Deel, averaging 220% of quota over two years and ranking top 5 of 1,000+ reps globally, and dropped out of grad school at Bath to build Stratum.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=108348&key=user_uploads/1648613/40ac0440-bf77-46cf-b30e-370f734c3203)

* Know someone who runs adjudication at a federal, state, or local agency? Intro us.

launches.body:
Hey YC! We're Alfredo and Ranad, the founders of Omanta.

**TL;DR: Omanta creates a personalized research lab around a single patient. We integrate a patient’s complete medical record, personal genomics, and use AI to take on the most complex cancer cases. Our researchers tackled GitLab co-founder Sid Sijbrandij’s case, helping bring him into complete remission.**

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EkZaq_fENqI>

\
**Why this matters**\
If you're a cancer patient, you'd think the hardest cases have entire teams dedicated to solving them. The reality: most doctors have about 20 minutes per patient, while the science never stops moving. New discoveries emerge every day, yet reaching standard clinical care can take over a decade (\~17 years on average). Physicians make high-stakes decisions with limited time, and even the most difficult cases rarely have anyone whose full-time job is to interrogate every layer of that one patient's disease and push the newest science toward their treatment.

That's the gap we built Omanta to close.\
\
**What we do**\
We meet patients wherever they are in their journey. We integrate their complete medical record and personal genomics with AI and clinical evidence to understand the molecular drivers of their disease. Then we map every existing therapy against their biology, and if the right therapy doesn't exist, we build it, from cancer vaccines and immunotherapies to highly targeted radioligand therapies.\
\
We've worked on some of the most complex cancer cases in the world. Most notably, **Alfredo was the genomics lead for the personalized therapeutic campaign behind GitLab founder Sid Sijbrandij's complete remission**, partnering with leading institutions to pursue personalized mRNA/DNA vaccines, CAR-T programs, drug repurposing, expanded-access therapies, and continuous molecular monitoring. We've seen what becomes possible when the full force of modern science is organized around a single person, and Omanta brings that depth of investigation to every case.\
\
**Why us**\
We met eight years ago working on early CRISPR cancer research and have been building toward this ever since.

* **Alfredo Gonzalez, PhD (CEO)** — translational genomics. Led the year-long investigation of 25TB of sequencing and molecular data for Sid Sijbrandij, key missing information in existing genomic reports, and uncovered actionable findings that reshaped his therapeutic strategy, including personalized mRNA/DNA vaccines, CAR-T, expanded access, drug repurposing, and continuous monitoring. PhD at UCLA, where he built one of the world's largest centralized multi-omic datasets for rare tumors. Previously at the Broad Institute (Cancer Dependency Map, validating targets from large-scale CRISPR screens) and Harvard's Wagers Lab.
* **Ranad Humeidi, PhD (CSO)** — chemical biologist. Earned her PhD in Chemical Biology from Harvard in three years, where she identified a druggable mechanism in ulcerative colitis that became the basis of a multimillion-dollar GSK collaboration. Built and directed a multimillion-dollar scientific program centered on a single rare-cancer patient, then went on to direct scientific strategy for 12+ medically complex patients after standard options were exhausted. At the Broad, she co-created and co-led a fellowship turning scientific discoveries into companies.

\
**Our ask**

* Intros. If you or someone you love is facing a difficult cancer diagnosis, we want to hear from you.
* We're also looking to connect with physicians who want a dedicated research team behind their most complex cases.
* Reach us here on Bookface or at [alfredo@omanta.com](mailto:alfredo@omanta.com) & [ranad@omanta.com](mailto:ranad@omanta.com).

launches.title: Hubble: Retrieve medical records other APIs can't
launches.tagline: Your user verifies their identity once, and we return their medical records through one API.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Hubble gives your product a patient's medical records through a single API. Your user verifies their identity once, and we assemble their records from across the providers they've seen and return them for your AI agent to use. Where APIs are not sufficient, we keep going with AI (browser and voice agents). Every request runs on the patient's individual right of access.

**The problem**\
If you're building something that needs a patient's records, there's no clean way to get them. A patient's history is scattered across every provider they've ever seen, and each system is its own island. Most APIs returns the patient-portal subset rather than the full record, and coverage is inconsistent because every health system sets up its integration differently. So most teams either build per-provider integrations for months, fall back to faxes and manual portal logins, or push the problem back onto the patient by asking them to track down their own records or remember a login they set up years ago and have long since lost.

**What Hubble does**\
Your user verifies their identity once, and we go get their records so you don't have to.

* **One verification, no work on your end.** The patient verifies their identity in a couple clicks. After that, assembling the records is our job, not yours and not theirs.
* **We don't stop at the portal subset.** We connect into EHRs and HIEs where they work, and when an API comes back empty we keep going.
* **Browser and voice agents for everything else.** Agents submit the patient's request through provider portals and call records departments on the patient's behalf, working the phone trees so nobody on your team has to.
* **Built on the patient's right of access.** Every request runs on the patient's individual right of access. They review every source we request from and can revoke at any time. Every retrieval is logged.

**About the team**\
We're the team behind the AI agents at Grow Therapy and Amazon's One Medical, used by millions of patients. Prabha was Grow's first PM building and scaling their AI agents. Aaron built the AI infrastructure at One Medical serving 1M+ clients. (Fun fact: we've known each other for over a decade.)

* If your product needs patient records, reach out and we'll get you access: [prabha@hubble.ai](mailto:prabha@hubble.ai)
* Intros to anyone building AI products on patient data, in digital health, care delivery, life sciences, or legal tech.

Sign up at [hubble.ai](http://hubble.ai)

launches.title: Avoca Systems: AI-powered radiology scheduling and communications
launches.tagline: Automating radiology scheduling and patient communications
launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋

We’re Max Shand and Campbell Mercer, co-founders of Avoca Systems.

TL;DR: Avoca automates patient scheduling and communications for radiology groups. Our radiology-specific AI handles calls, online scheduling, faxes and e-referrals, guiding patients from referral and booking through to results and follow-up. We’re already live across more than 250 clinics, including networks operating 150+ locations.

<https://youtu.be/ZU3Ebvs5Mk0>

**What it does**

Radiology scheduling is unusually complex. A valid appointment can depend on the modality, body region, contrast requirements, patient history, preparation instructions, equipment availability, staff qualifications and referring-provider details.

These rules are fragmented across legacy systems, spreadsheets and the tacit knowledge of experienced receptionists. Generic voice and scheduling tools struggle to bring them together.

Avoca integrates with a radiology network’s existing systems and turns its workflows and operational knowledge into one automation layer:

* **AI calls:** Answers inbound calls and runs outbound campaigns for bookings, rescheduling, cancellations, preparation questions and general enquiries.
* **Online scheduling:** Lets patients upload their referral, complete the necessary clinical and safety questions, and find an appropriate appointment in real time.
* **Fax and e-referral automation:** Ingests and interprets referrals, identifies missing information and contacts patients to complete their booking.
* **Operational intelligence:** Encodes each network’s booking rules, rosters, staff capabilities, preferences and tacit knowledge so Avoca can safely fill available scanner capacity.
* **Patient communications:** Guides patients through preparation, intake, reminders, results and follow-up using voice, text and email.

**Why this matters**

Up to 30% of calls into radiology centres go unanswered as patients wait on hold. Referrals arrive through phones, websites, faxes and electronic systems, leaving staff to manually interpret documents, contact patients and coordinate appointments across multiple systems.

At the same time, radiology providers face staff shortages, rising operating costs and reimbursement pressure. Missed calls and unprocessed referrals mean patients wait longer while valuable scanner capacity goes unfilled.

Avoca helps networks capture more patient demand, reduce administrative work and complete more scans using their existing clinics, equipment and clinical systems.

**Traction**

* Partnered with 250+ clinics, including several of Australia’s largest radiology networks
* Reduced call abandonment from approximately 30% to 2%
* Patient satisfaction averaging 4.6/5
* More than 80% booking conversion for eligible patient calls in major deployments
* Integrated with leading radiology and healthcare systems, including Visage, Karisma, Comrad, Epic, Oracle Health and eClinicalWorks
* Now expanding into the United States

**Why we’re building this**

I (Max) was the first employee at Afterpay and later founded and sold Serenade. Cam was previously a principal engineer at Honey Insurance and Macquarie. Across those experiences, we saw how much better an industry can operate when complex workflows are turned into simple, intuitive products.

Healthcare is a chaotic mess of work that falls between systems: calls that go unanswered, referrals that sit in fax queues and operational knowledge that exists only in the heads of experienced staff.

We started with radiology because the scheduling complexity is exceptionally high and the consolidation of radiology clinics into large groups allowed us to focus our GTM efforts on just a few influential stakeholders who acutely feel the pain we’re solving for.

**Our big** **ask**

* Any introduction to a radiology network or health system chief executive (CEO, CIO, COO, CDO, CRO - even the new brand of CAIO - Chief AI Officer) would be hugely appreciated. We’re new to the US and eager to meet leaders tackling the patient access and scheduling challenges we’re solving.

Finally, if you operate a radiology network - or know someone who does - we’d love to hear from you. Please reply here or reach us at [hello@avocasystems.com](mailto:hello@avocasystems.com).

launches.title: Allia: The first full-stack, AI-native mental health group
launches.tagline: 8000+ independent mental health clinicians in America already run their practice on Allia. We turn that network into one national clinical group that delivers coordinated, measurable care and contracts with the country's largest payers.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Allia is the first full-stack, AI-native mental health group. We have **$50M+ in annualized national insurance contracts** and will begin delivering care in September 2026.

We bring independent practices into one national clinical group that can deliver, measure, and improve care at scale: **600+ clinicians across 70 locations in 32 states, plus telehealth nationwide.**

Every clinician runs on a single intelligent system of record powered by collective intelligence at a scale, no independent practice could achieve alone.

<https://youtu.be/PIefc1pitT0>

### **How we got here**

We have the fastest-growing distribution base in behavioral health: 8000+ independent mental health clinicians in America already run their practice on Allia. That's 1,000+ practices every day, caring for 300,000+ patients. It's our wedge: clinicians adopt the OS to run their practice, and we convert those practices into our clinical group.

### **What Allia does**

Allia is a clinical group that gives independent mental health practices the coordination, infrastructure, and payer contracts of a connected health system,  while letting them stay independent. 

1. **One coordinated group.** Because every practice operates as part of Allia, care no longer stops at the walls of a single office. Patients move through therapy, psychiatry, primary care, specialty, and higher levels of care as one coordinated journey across a single entity.
2. **Care that stays connected.** Allia matches each patient to the right clinician and coordinates what comes next across the full continuum of care. Referrals are tracked through completion, so patients are never left to navigate the system alone.
3. **Operations that run in the background.** Eligibility, intake, scheduling, documentation, coding, billing, follow-ups, and payer reporting happen automatically as care is delivered. Far less gets chased by hand, so clinicians spend their time on patients, not paperwork.
4. **Outcomes that become visible.** Measurement-informed care, powered by our proprietary agentic technology, is built into every patient's journey, identifying who is improving, who is disengaging, and who needs a change in treatment. The group turns that evidence into better care across the continuum, and into the outcome data that earns better payer contracts.

### **Traction**

* $50M+ in annualized care capacity under signed national contracts with America's largest health insurance companies
* 8,000+ clinicians across 1,000+ practices use Allia every day (our distribution wedge); 600+ are already activated into the clinical group.
* 300,000+ patients supported across the network

### **Team**

* **Amie Leighton (CEO):** dropped out of Oxford and declined a place at medical school to build Allia.
* **Saroosh Khan (CTO):** 94.2% on ARC-AGI-2 (next best: 74%, Google DeepMind); first to cross the 85% "human-like reasoning" threshold. Built Allia's deep-reasoning population-health agent, the first inside a system of record for medicine.
* **Clinical team:** former CMO of the nation's largest behavioral health company **(IPO >$8B)**, former CMO of the country's **3rd-largest health plan,** and leaders who scaled the biggest names in behavioral health.

### **What we're looking for**

Intros to health systems and mental health practices who want to join with the group. Reach out: [team@allia.health](mailto:team@allia.health)
